chunks: He said: And al-Rida (peace be upon him) said, regarding the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, then for it' -- there is a Lord who forgives it.

key_terms.أحسنتم: You do good, you act virtuously
key_terms.أسأتم: You do evil, you act wrongly

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Rida interpret the Quran verse about doing good and evil?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) provides a unique interpretation of Quran 17:7, adding that even when one does evil, there is a Lord who can forgive it. This commentary transforms a verse about personal accountability into one that also emphasizes divine mercy and the possibility of forgiveness.
